Yes. Every tool is free with no watermark, no account, and no daily limits. Processing happens on your device, so there is no per-use server cost to pass on to you.

No. Open any tool, then turn on airplane mode — everything still works. Your documents never leave your browser tab.
Can I use PDF Suite offline?
Yes. After your first visit, install the app and all 36 tools work without internet — on planes, in offices with strict firewalls, anywhere.
